items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I was there before Jimmy, but I didn't stay there and graduate. I came back to Chicago when Jimmy went there.

ctx.x: Well, there was something wrong with the damn machine. It knocked the cord -- were you saying you used to hang out with Joe Smith and Bubber Miley?

Joe Smith, Bubber Miley, myself, all, bunch of us, you know, up to the nightclub because Joe was with Fletcher. And Bubber worked with this -- Down here in the Central Park. He worked with this white band. See, Bubber -- (DANCE: Leo Reisman, (CALDWELL) Right, Bubbles (unintelligible), and we'd all -- they'd get through. We'd all go uptown here and hang out with all the musicians and fellows, you know. And we'd sit up there, the six hills (unintelligible). Jimmy stayed open from one hour to the next hour. They'd…

of us, and he was always -- we'd always get together, but he had a tragic -- he had a style. Only one ever could play that style like him was this boy, Howard Scott. And when Joe left, Howard could play just like that style, beautiful style.
